_comment: VIRAL VIBE / EMOTION — one clip, 8–15s, two text blocks, music at 50%, no voiceover. Generalised from a production config; every project-specific value is a <placeholder> describing what belongs there. See references/formats.md §2.
_startingPoint: A proven starting point, not a spec. The 15s cap, the two-block text and the silence all worked for someone else's audience — tweak them for yours, one variable per experiment. Inventing a different format entirely is encouraged: references/formats.md.

meta.title: <slug-for-this-video>
meta.concept: <the feeling this video creates, and where the product quietly sits inside it>

segments._durationRule: One clip, no cuts. Clip under 8s → loop it once (final = clip × 2). 8–15s → use as-is. Over 15s → trim to 15. Never pad with black or a freeze frame — the format is the calm, and a frozen tail kills it.

backgroundFootage.file: <shared/assets/vibe-clips/ — 9:16, slow, meditative: someone alone reading, walking, working somewhere beautiful. Nothing that moves fast.>
backgroundFootage._crop: If the source isn't 1080×1920, zoom-fill and centre-crop — never letterbox.

textOverlay._style: Quiet on purpose, and a deliberate exception to references/ffmpeg-text-style.md: a serif face, pure white, centred on both axes, NO outline unless the clip is bright enough to wash the text out. Both blocks the same size. Roughly 60pt at 1080×1920.
textOverlay.font: <a serif face in shared/assets/fonts/ — the quiet register, not the bold sans>
lines: <SETUP — the ordinary version of the thing. Wraps to 3 lines or fewer at this size.>
<TURN — the same sentence, ending on what your product is for. This is the whole sell: it must land as a third, different kind of the thing, and it must NOT name the product.>
textOverlay._writingNote: Both halves of the setup should be common, recognisable, and contrast with each other — one classic, one modern, or two different categories — so the turn reads as a surprise rather than a list. If the user hasn't supplied the pair, offer 3–5 and let them pick.

_voiceNote: Never a voiceover in this format. The silence is the format.

musicBackground.file: <shared/assets/music/ — a bed you have the rights to, already trimmed so the first note hits at 0s>
musicBackground._note: Replaces the clip's own audio entirely. 0.5 is right because nothing competes with it.

caption._comment: The explicit product mention lives HERE, not on screen. Optional even here — an unbranded vibe video that gets reach is doing its job.
caption.text: <one line that names <PRODUCT NAME> and what it's for, plus hashtags>

_rules: Cap the output at 15s. The look is meditative; longer breaks the format.
Never reuse a clip a previous run used — the config of each run is the record (references/duplicate-safety.md). When the clip folder is exhausted, generate variations rather than repeating.
Never name the product on screen. On-screen selling breaks the spell this format depends on.
